name: brooklyn-marketplace-auction-house

scripts.build: npm run check && npm test && node scripts/build-static.mjs
scripts.check: find api lib scripts tests -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && node --check app.js && node --check analytics.js && node --check catalog.js
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run contracts:test && npm run repo:check
scripts.test: node tests/smoke.mjs && node tests/backend.mjs && node tests/delivery.mjs && node tests/resale.mjs && node tests/resale-seller-actions.mjs && node tests/resale-indexer.mjs && node tests/sponsored-userop.mjs && node tests/owner-exit.mjs && node tests/marketplace-qol.mjs && node tests/synthetic-social-auth.mjs && node tests/wallet-provisioning.mjs && node tests/passkey-provisioning-ui.mjs && node tests/stripe-launch.mjs && node tests/public-export.mjs

description: Open-source marketplace reference; no operator configuration or production authorization included.
